design: Long-limbed female adult courier with a small arched cranial crest, slender angular mandibles and dreadlocks woven into a high horizontal loop at the back. Twin thin hard dispatch folios crossing at the back, minimal crossed travel straps over a plain sleeveless tunic, narrow wrapped sash and one leg pouch. Left hand lifted to wrist communicator, right relaxed with slightly spread clawed fingers. Burnished amber hide.
